crossRefs.note: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

people.name: Fair_Havens
people.line: Harbor on Crete; Paul's ship stopped during journey to Rome

people.name: Lasea
people.line: A city near Fair Havens, Crete

translations.web: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.
translations.bsb: After we had moved along the coast with difficulty, we came to a place called Fair Havens, near the town of Lasea.
translations.kjv: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
translations.asv: and with difficulty coasting along it we came unto a certain place called Fair Havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
